cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial driver screen renders with all seven utilities and the action footer
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Sign on as an authorized admin operator.
2. From the Administrator Menu select the data-utilities option (start transaction ORUT).
3. Observe the initial screen.
cases.expected: The Admin Data-Utilities screen appears with the heading 「ADMIN DATA UTILITIES」 and the seven numbered utilities 「1. Rebuild/validate card xref  (OUXREF)」, 「2. Build monthly statements    (OUSTMB)」, 「3. Delinquency + expiry flags  (OUFLAG)」, 「4. Import accounts from feed   (OUIMP)」, 「5. Archive aged transactions   (OUARCH)」, 「6. Purge aged transactions     (OUPURG)」, 「7. Backup transactions to feed (OUBKP)」. The entry captions 「Option:」, 「Mode:」, 「Cutoff/Due:」, 「Cycle:」 and 「Max count:」 are shown, the message line shows 「Select a utility (1-7), key params, press ENTER.」, and the footer shows 「ENTER=Run  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear」.
cases.remark: OCUTIL 1000-SEND-INITIAL (SEND MAP MUTILA/MUTIL ERASE L142); message M1 (ERRMSGO L134). Footer literal MUTIL row 36 L24. UI §2.1.

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Header band shows transaction, program, system title and current date/time
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Admin Data-Utilities screen.
2. Read the top two header lines.
cases.expected: The header shows 「Tran:」 = 「ORUT」, 「Pgm :」 = 「OCUTIL」, the system title 「ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM」, 「Date:」 with the current date (e.g. 「2026-09-28」) and 「Time:」 with the current time (e.g. 「14:30:05」).
cases.remark: 8000-POPULATE-HEADER (TRNNAMEO=ORUT, PGMNAMEO=OCUTIL, TITLEO) + 8500-GET-DATE-TIME (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME, DATESEP '-', TIMESEP ':'). WHEAD WS-HDR-TITLE. UI §2.1 rows 1-9.

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the Mode field defaults to REBL and the cursor rests on Option
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Admin Data-Utilities screen.
2. Without typing, check the entry fields and cursor position.
cases.expected: The 「Mode:」 field is pre-filled with the default 「REBL」; 「Option:」, 「Cutoff/Due:」, 「Cycle:」 and 「Max count:」 are empty; and the cursor (initial focus) is positioned on the 「Option:」 field, ready for a 1-digit utility number.
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL MOVE 'REBL' to UTMODEO L133. BMS UTOPT = UNPROT/IC/FSET (initial cursor). WS-OPTION value ZEROS. UI §2.1 item-states 'Initial display'.

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Result area is output-only and blank until a utility has run
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Admin Data-Utilities screen.
2. Try to type into the result area (Status field, result message and the four result lines).
cases.expected: The result fields — 「Status:」, the result message and the four result lines — are display-only (the cursor cannot enter them) and are blank; they populate only after a utility has been run. The entry fields 「Option:」/「Mode:」/「Cutoff/Due:」/「Cycle:」/「Max count:」 are enterable on the initial display and become display-only after a run.
cases.remark: BMS RSTAT/RMSG/RLINE1-4 ASKIP/NORM (display); UTOPT/UTMODE/UTDATE/UTCYC/UTNUM UNPROT. UI §2.1 item-states (entry ○ initial/selected, □ after run). Populated by 5100-5700 FMT only.

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Counts are shown zero-suppressed with separators; amounts signed with two decimals
cases.precondition: F-STD; run a utility whose result returns a large read count (e.g. 1,234,567), a zero written count, and a negative amount (e.g. -12,345.67).
cases.steps:
1. Run a utility (e.g. Option 「2」 Build monthly statements, which returns monetary totals) that yields those counts.
2. Read the result count and amount fields.
cases.data: Read/Acct-read count = 1234567, a zero count = 0, an amount total = -12345.67.
cases.expected: The count shows as 「1,234,567」 (leading zeros suppressed, thousands separators), a zero count shows as 「0」, and a monetary total shows signed with two decimals as 「-12,345.67」. Note: the amount edit field holds at most 9 integer digits, so a returned amount of 10+ integer digits is truncated at the high-order end on display.
cases.remark: WS-E9 PIC ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9 (counts) L74; WS-EA PIC -,---,---,--9.99 (amounts, 9 int digits) L75. FMT paragraphs 5100-5700.

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)

cases.precondition: F-STD; the initial screen is displayed.

cases.expected: No utility runs; the screen stays on Admin Data-Utilities and the message line shows 「Enter a utility number 1 through 7.」 (the required-field prompt).

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Mode and Cutoff/Due are accepted as typed (no driver-side format check)
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. In 「Option:」 type 「5」 (Archive aged transactions).
2. In 「Cutoff/Due:」 type 「2025-01-31」.
3. Optionally type any 4-character 「Mode:」 value.
4. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The driver does not itself validate the Mode or Cutoff/Due format; it forwards them unchanged to the utility (here the archive cutoff date). The utility runs and any date/mode validity is the sub-program's responsibility; the run proceeds and shows 「Utility complete - see counts below.」.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUTS MOVE UTMODEI→WS-REQ-MODE L236, UTDATEI→WS-REQ-DATE L237 — INSPECT only, no format edit. Forwarded via 3500-DO-ARCH KAR-CUTOFF L331. Documents validation absence.

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Pseudo-conversational re-entry: first entry shows the screen, next ENTER is processed
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction ORUT fresh (no prior communication area) — the screen appears.
2. Type Option 「1」 and press ENTER.
cases.expected: On the first entry the initial screen is displayed (nothing is processed). The transaction ends returning to itself, so the next ENTER is treated as input and Option 「1」 is processed (Rebuild/validate card xref runs).
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN: EIBCALEN=0 or CA-FIRST-ENTER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (sets CA-PGM-CONTEXT=1 L143); else 2000-PROCESS-INPUT. RETURN TRANSID('ORUT') L747. KCOMM CA-FIRST-ENTER=0 / CA-RE-ENTER=1.

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Blank Mode is substituted with the utility's default before the run
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. In 「Option:」 type 「1」 and leave 「Mode:」 blank; press ENTER (observe the mode passed to xref).
2. Clear, then type 「Option:」 = 「3」 and leave 「Mode:」 blank; press ENTER (observe the mode passed to flags).
cases.data: Step 1: Option = 「1」, Mode = (blank). Step 2: Option = 「3」, Mode = (blank).
cases.expected: When Mode is left blank the driver supplies the utility's own default: 「REBL」 for Rebuild/validate card xref (Option 1) and 「BOTH」 for Delinquency + expiry flags (Option 3). Each utility then runs and shows 「Utility complete - see counts below.」.
cases.remark: 3100-DO-XREF IF WS-REQ-MODE = SPACES → 'REBL' to KUX-MODE L271; 3300-DO-FLAG IF SPACES → 'BOTH' to KFL-MODE L302. On initial display UTMODEO already shows 'REBL' (1000-SEND-INITIAL).

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Max count with leading spaces is parsed to the number (embedded spaces skipped)
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. In 「Option:」 type 「4」.
2. In 「Max count:」 type 「  100」 (two leading spaces then 100).
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The leading spaces are skipped and the value is read as 100; the import utility runs capped at 100 records and shows 「Utility complete - see counts below.」.
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-NUM: WHEN WS-NC-CHAR = SPACE → CONTINUE L650-651; digits accumulate WS-NC-VALUE; ≥1 digit required (WS-NC-DIGITS). WS-MAX-NUM→KIM-MAX.

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Successful xref result populates status, message and all count lines (column-level)
cases.precondition: F-STD; run Option 「1」 (Rebuild/validate card xref) with data that yields non-zero counts.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「1」 and press ENTER.
2. Read the whole result block.
cases.data: Utility returns status OK, Read=12000, Written=11950, Updated=40, Skip-acct=5, Skip-xref=3, Skip-cust=2, Errors=0, More=N.
cases.expected: The 「Status:」 field and result message show the utility's own status; the four result lines read as 「Read=12,000   Written=11,950」, 「Updated=40   Skip-acct=5」, 「Skip-xref=3   Skip-cust=2」, 「Errors=0   More=N」; and the message line shows 「Utility complete - see counts below.」.
cases.remark: 5100-FMT-XREF L388-419: KUX-STATUS→RSTATO, KUX-MSG→RMSGO, count labels Read/Written/Updated/Skip-acct/Skip-xref/Skip-cust/Errors/More via 7100-FMT2 (label=value pairs). Column-level.

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Statement-build result shows monetary totals signed with two decimals
cases.precondition: F-STD; run Option 「2」 (Build monthly statements) with data returning credit/debit totals.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」, Cycle 「202601」 and press ENTER.
2. Read the totals line.
cases.data: Utility returns Tot cr = 250000.00, Tot dr = -180000.50.
cases.expected: The totals result line shows 「Tot cr=250,000.00   Tot dr=-180,000.50」 — monetary values edited signed with two decimals — alongside the Acct-read/Stmts/No-tran/Errors count lines; the message line shows 「Utility complete - see counts below.」.
cases.remark: 5200-FMT-STMB L443-449: KSM-TOT-CREDIT/KSM-TOT-DEBIT → WS-EA (PIC -,---,---,--9.99) → RLINE3O. Amount content variant (vs count-only xref).

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Business-error result: utility reports an error status but the driver still completes normally
cases.precondition: F-STD; run a utility that links normally but returns an internal error status (e.g. Option 「2」 with a cycle that has no billable data). *(needs real data)*
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」, Cycle 「209912」 (no data) and press ENTER.
2. Read the message line and the Status field.
cases.data: Option = 「2」, Cycle = 「209912」; utility returns an error/warning status in its result area.
cases.expected: Because the CICS link itself succeeds, the message line still shows 「Utility complete - see counts below.」, while the 「Status:」 field and result message reflect the utility's own error/warning status and the counts show the failure. The driver does not re-evaluate the sub-program status for its own message.
cases.remark: 2100-RUN L199-203: message chosen only on WS-LINK-BAD (LINK RESP), NOT on KSM-STATUS. Status shown via 5200-FMT-STMB KSM-STATUS→RSTATO. Distinct from LINK failure (UT_UTIL_ABNORMAL_006). Driver behaves correctly → Normal.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Utility cannot be started (target sub-program unavailable)
cases.precondition: F-STD; the target sub-program for the chosen utility is disabled/undefined in CICS so its invocation fails. *(needs real data)*
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「1」 (whose sub-program OUXREF is disabled).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Option = 「1」 with OUXREF disabled (invocation returns a not-normal response, e.g. PGMIDERR).
cases.expected: No result counts are trusted; the screen stays on Admin Data-Utilities and the message line shows 「Sub-program link failed - check resources.」.
cases.remark: 4000-LINK-SUB: IF WS-RESP-CD NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL) → WS-LINK-BAD='Y' L376; 2100-RUN IF WS-LINK-BAD='Y' → M2 (ERRMSGO L200) → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY. UI §3 row 2. Runtime fault injection needed.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Max count at the 7-digit field maximum is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「4」 (Import accounts).
2. In 「Max count:」 type 「9999999」 (seven 9s, the field maximum).

cases.expected: The value 9,999,999 is accepted as the record cap; the import utility runs with that limit and shows 「Utility complete - see counts below.」.
cases.remark: UTNUM field 7 chars, WS-MAX-NUM PIC 9(07) L49 → max 9999999; 6000-PARSE-NUM len 7 → WS-MAX-NUM→KIM-MAX L320. Upper field boundary.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Blank Max count is treated as zero (no cap)
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「1」 (Rebuild/validate card xref).
2. Leave 「Max count:」 empty.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The blank Max count is not validated and stays zero; a zero cap is passed to the utility (meaning no record limit). The utility runs over all records and shows 「Utility complete - see counts below.」.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUTS: WS-MAX-NUM initialized ZEROS L240; UTNUMI spaces → parse skipped → WS-MAX-NUM stays 0 → KUX-MAX L275. Zero/blank lower boundary.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Cycle is checked only for numeric digits, not for a valid month
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」 (Build monthly statements).
2. In 「Cycle:」 type 「209913」 (month 13 — numeric but not a valid month).
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The driver accepts the cycle because it only checks that all characters are numeric (YYYYMM digit check), not that the month is 01-12; the value 209913 is forwarded to the statement build. Any month-range validity is the sub-program's responsibility.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUTS: UTCYCI numeric → 6000-PARSE-NUM only rejects non-digits; no month-range check → WS-CYC-NUM→KSM-CYCLE L287. Documents boundary of the numeric-only rule (M7 fires only on non-numeric).
